meta.title: Cimo live preview
meta.description: Installs Cimo, then opens Media → Add New so a JPG or PNG can be optimized to WebP in the browser.
meta.author: bfintal

options.blogdescription: Upload a large JPG or PNG and watch it become WebP in your browser.

steps.code:
Upload a large JPG or PNG and watch Cimo optimize it to WebP in your browser, before WordPress saves the file.

Drop a file on the Image block below, or open Media → Add New. Cimo runs on your device, with no quotas and no external image server. Quality and resize options are under Settings → Cimo.
